production.note: US model years. First: Mazda's '2006 MX-5 MIATA' brochure introduces the 2.0-litre car. Last: Mazda's 2015 MX-5 Miata brochure still lists it (mazda-us-2015-mx5-brochure); the fourth-generation ND was sold as a 2016 model (see the existing ND record). No opened Mazda page states in so many words that 2015 was the last NC model year.

body.note: Two-seat open car sold with a 'Black cloth convertible soft top' or a 'Power Retractable Hard Top' (PRHT). Both are the same variant and both are Roadster under the data guide, which has no separate body value for a retractable hardtop; the PRHT name is in the aliases.

configuration.note: 'MZR 2.0L DOHC 16-valve 4-cylinder engine with variable valve timing (VVT)'

aspiration.note: No forced induction is mentioned; the words 'naturally aspirated' do not appear

drivetrain.note: 'Its front-midship-engine placement and rear-wheel-drive layout enhance balance and directional control.'

transmission.note: Manual: '5-speed with short-throw shifter' (Sport), '6-speed close-ratio with short-throw shifter' (Touring, Grand Touring); automatic: '6-speed Sport with Adaptive Shift Logic'. The 2006 brochure lists the same three (mazda-us-2006-mx5-brochure).

powerHp.note: Manual transmission, 2010 model year. Quote: "Horsepower - Manual transmission 167 hp @ 7000 rpm - Automatic transmission 158 hp @ 6700 rpm". The 2009 brochure gives "167 hp @ 7000 rpm" (mazda-us-2009-mx5-brochure) and the 2015 brochure "167 @ 7,000 rpm" (mazda-us-2015-mx5-brochure). 167 hp applied to 2009-2015, seven of the ten model years. The 2006-2008 cars were rated 170 hp with the manual and 166 hp with the automatic: "Horsepower, SAE Net 170 @ 6700 rpm" (mazda-us-2006-mx5-brochure).

weightLb.note: Sport (base trim, soft top) with the 5-speed manual, 2010 model year. Quote: "Curb weight (lbs) - MT 2480 2511 2511 - AT 2542" (Sport, Touring, Grand Touring). No 2009 Mazda curb weight was found (the 2009 brochure has none), so 2010 is the reference year. The 2015 brochure gives the same 2,480 lb for the 5-speed car and 2,593 lb for a 6-speed PRHT (mazda-us-2015-mx5-brochure). The 2006 brochure gives "5-speed manual (MX-5, Touring) 2474 lb" for the 170 hp car (mazda-us-2006-mx5-brochure).

discrepancies.reason: Model year. Mazda rated the manual car 170 hp for 2006-2008 and 167 hp from 2009 to 2015.
discrepancies.resolution: Used 167 hp, the rating for seven of the ten model years; the reference model year is 2010, the first 167 hp year with a Mazda curb weight found.
